report_name: Banbury Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify existing cycling demand, estimate future potential under different scenarios, and inform the development and prioritisation of the proposed cycle network.
other_tools_developed: Rapid Cycleway Prioritisation Tool, CycleStreets low traffic neighbourhoods tool, and a custom prioritisation table based on factors including safety implications and connectivity enhancement.
specific_evidence_of_impact: Public consultation feedback led to significant alterations to the final document, including updates to proposal clarity and changes to route maps. Additionally, the LCWIP process has already secured infrastructure commitments from development sites, such as improvements to the M40 tunnel, an off-carriageway cycle path along Old Daventry Road, off-road cycle lanes on Warwick Road, and contributions toward upgrading the canal towpath.
